events.description: Effort by Bin Ladin's agents to purchase uranium (weapons-grade nuclear material), per CIA reporting. Much of the text is redacted.
Late November 1996 public statements in which Bin Ladin warned that "qualitative operations" would be necessary to pursue "a real battle between the Islamic Nation and US forces."
CIA Counterterrorist Center issues commentary CTC 97-30002 assessing that Bin Ladin is trying to develop a WMD capability.
Effort by Bin Ladin's agents to purchase uranium (the text is heavily redacted and garbled).

In public statements in late November, Bin Ladin warned that 'qualitative operations' would be necessary to pursue a real battle between the Islamic Nation and US forces. The year is inferred from the 6 January 1997 document date.
CTC commentary issued assessing that Bin Ladin is trying to develop a WMD capability.

sources_cited: CIA Counterterrorist Center Commentary CTC 97-30002 (6 January 1997)
key_claims: CTC assesses that Bin Ladin is taking steps to develop the capability to use WMD (possibly chemical agents, biological toxins and nuclear material) in terrorist operations.
CTC reports that Bin Ladin's agents tried in 1994 to purchase uranium.
CTC notes that Bin Ladin may plan to give such substances to supporters.
CTC judges that access to WMD material could strongly abet Bin Ladin's stated intention to act against the US presence in the Persian Gulf region.
CTC says it does not know exactly what Bin Ladin might be threatening or how serious he is about following threats with action.
